title: Best Book Marketing Experts (2026): How to Hire One
h1: Best Book and eBook Marketing Experts
description: How to hire a book marketing expert: what the service should include, how to brief it, what drives the price and the red flags for authors.
intro: Book marketing helps readers discover your book through store listings, ads, newsletters, social media and reviews. For self-published authors in particular, marketing is often the difference between a book that sells and one that disappears. It goes wrong when services promise bestseller status, buy fake reviews, or spend ad budgets without tracking results. This guide helps authors hire marketing help that respects the rules.

faq.q: What does book marketing usually include?
faq.a: Improving your store listing and description, choosing categories and keywords, running ads on book stores or social media, newsletter promotions, launch planning and author platform building.
They can help you reach real readers, for example through review copy programs or advance reader teams. Paying for reviews or using fake reviews breaks store rules and can get your book removed.
They can, especially for series and genres with strong reader demand. Ads need testing and monitoring. Keep ad accounts in your name and set budgets.
Ideally before launch, with a cover, description, pre-order page and a plan for launch week. Marketing can also revive older books.

faq.q: Is my book ready to market?
faq.a: Check the cover, description and the first pages. Marketing sends readers to your book page, so it must be convincing when they arrive.
